manifest.name: dsh-papercut
manifest.description: Papercut explainer films, end to end: script -> local TTS -> word-level captions -> Remotion render, natively on Windows (no WSL, no ffmpeg install).

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: papercut
      name: dsh-papercut
      config:
        # Absolute path of a papercut workspace: the folder that holds app/, src/papercut-explainer-main/,
        # episodes/ and tools/. Leave empty to use the PAPERCUT_ROOT env var, then the built-in default.
        root: ''
        # Local IndexTTS-2.5 bridge. The plugin never spawns the model itself (that would eat VRAM);
        # it only probes /health and tells you how to start the service when it is down.
        ttsUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7865
        python: D:/tts/index-tts/.venv/Scripts/python.exe
        # Headless Chromium for Remotion + the audio engine. Edge ships with Windows.
        chromePath: C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe
        defaultModel: small
        debug: false
# The 9 papercut skills are plain Agent Skills folders. They are installed to
# <DSH_HOME>/skills by `node scripts/install-skills.mjs` (also run by `npm run skills`),
# which is the user-level skill directory every profile already scans — no patch to the
# first-party skill provider needed, and no chance of colliding with its own config.

readme.text:
**Papercut explainer films, end to end — natively on Windows, no WSL.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that turns one sentence of
idea into a finished vertical (9:16) cut-paper explainer: script → local text-to-speech →
word-level timed captions → Remotion render → QA contact sheets.

```
$ dsh --profile papercut
> 做一个关于剪纸的 25 秒短片
   → papercut_plan → papercut_voice → papercut_storyboard → papercut_render → papercut_qa
   → episodes/01-jianzhi/papercut/out/jianzhi-papercut.mp4   (1080×1920, 27.5 s, −14.7 LUFS)

The upstream [papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) library is a
beautiful Remotion kit, but its toolchain is 27 bash and Python scripts written for macOS
(Apple `rsync`, `mlx-whisper`, Homebrew `ffmpeg`, `readlink -f`). Everything that touches the
OS has been rewritten here in Node, so the whole pipeline runs on a stock Windows machine:

| Piece | Upstream | Here |
|---|---|---|
| Choreography | `render.py` + `render.sh` | `src/node/render.js` — one bundle, per-scene ProRes HQ segments, content-keyed cache |
| Audio mix | `mix.py` (numpy) | ffmpeg `sidechaincompress` + `alimiter` + `loudnorm` |
| Voice | `narrate.py` (qwen-tts) | local IndexTTS-2.5 bridge over HTTP |
| Word timing | `asr.py` (mlx-whisper) | `openai-whisper` + forced alignment against the known script (`py/align.py`) |
| Chromium | system Chrome | the Edge that ships with Windows |
| ffmpeg/ffprobe | `brew install` | bundled static binaries from npm |

No WSL. No Homebrew. No `ffmpeg` on `PATH`. Python is only needed for two leaf scripts
(forced alignment, CJK font subsetting), and the plugin calls the interpreter you point it at.

| Tool | Arguments | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `papercut_list` | — | Existing episodes, their duration, scene count and whether a render exists |
| `papercut_plan` | `idea`, `slug?`, `comp?`, `lines?` | Scaffolds the episode and returns the 7-line script brief |
| `papercut_storyboard` | `slug` | Camera / cut / SFX table derived from the real frame plan |
| `papercut_voice` | `slug`, `engine?`, `force?`, `model?`, `keepWarm?` | Local TTS per line, silence trim, forced word alignment, `voiceover.wav` + captions + plan |
| `papercut_render` | `slug`, `force?`, `workers?`, `conc?` | Segmented Remotion render, then one x264 pass with the audio bed |
| `papercut_qa` | `slug`, `every?`, `scale?` | Contact sheets every N frames, numbered, for visual review |

Everything else — composing scenes, writing the hook, choosing assets — is the agent's job,
guided by nine skills.

Installed into `<DSH_HOME>/skills` by `npm run skills`, so DSH picks them up live:

`papercut-explainer` (router / end-to-end) · `papercut-strategy` · `papercut-hook` ·
`papercut-script` · `papercut-storyboard` · `papercut-build` · `papercut-voice` ·
`papercut-qa` · `papercut-setup` (toolchain doctor for this machine).

Say "make a papercut reel about X" and the router takes it from there.
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile papercut add "link:D:/path/to/dsh-papercut"

cd D:/path/to/dsh-papercut
node scripts/install-skills.mjs

readme.section: in DSH: "check my papercut install"   -> runs the papercut-setup doctor
What the workspace must look like
readme.text:
`dsh-papercut` drives a *workspace* directory holding the upstream library and the render app.
The plugin finds it by walking up from its own package folder (and then from the current working
directory) looking for `app/node_modules` + `src/papercut-explainer-main/library`, so a linked
checkout and an npm-installed copy both work without configuration. Point it elsewhere with
`root` in `cordis.patch.yml`, or the `PAPERCUT_ROOT` env var.

readme.section: What the workspace must look like
readme.text:
```
<root>/
  app/                          Remotion project (node_modules with remotion, ffmpeg-static, ...)
  src/papercut-explainer-main/  the upstream MIT library (kit, audio engine, scenes template)
  episodes/<slug>/              one folder per film

Use `papercut-setup` (or `node tools/bin/papercut.mjs list`) to see what is missing.

- **Windows 10/11** with Edge (any modern Edge has the headless Chromium Remotion needs)
- **Node 22+**
- A Python 3.11 virtualenv with `openai-whisper` + `fonttools` — only for the aligner and
  the CJK font subsetter. Point at it with `python:` in the plugin config.
- **Optional**: a local TTS HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:7865` (IndexTTS-2.5). The plugin probes
  `/health` and tells you how to start it; it never spawns the model itself, because that would
  hold VRAM hostage.

First film, `episodes/01-jianzhi` (1080×1920, 30 fps, 824 frames):

| | |
|---|---|
| Voice + alignment | 7 lines, 24.1 s of speech, ~4 s synth + ~3.3 s align per line |
| Render (cold) | 55 s — bundle 2 s, 824 frames in 3 parallel workers, final encode 9 s |
| Render (one scene changed) | 20 s — cache hits on the other six segments |
| Output | H.264 High, yuv420p, bt709, 8.6 Mbps, −14.7 LUFS, −1.0 dBTP, 0 decode errors |

MIT. The bundled story kit comes from

**剪纸解说短片，一条龙做完 —— Windows 原生，不需要 WSL。**

这是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 插件：把一句选题变成一条
成品竖屏（9:16）剪纸风解说短片 —— 脚本 → 本地语音合成 → 逐词时间轴字幕 → Remotion 渲染 →
QA 抽帧图。

```
$ dsh --profile papercut
> 做一个关于剪纸的 25 秒短片
   → papercut_plan → papercut_voice → papercut_storyboard → papercut_render → papercut_qa
   → episodes/01-jianzhi/papercut/out/jianzhi-papercut.mp4   (1080×1920, 27.5s, −14.7 LUFS)

上游 [papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) 的 Remotion 素材库
很好，但工具链是 27 个给 macOS 写的 bash / Python 脚本（`rsync`、`mlx-whisper`、
Homebrew 的 `ffmpeg`、`readlink -f`）。本插件把所有碰系统的部分都改写成了 Node，
所以在一台干净的 Windows 上就能跑通全链路：

| 环节 | 上游 | 这里 |
|---|---|---|
| 编排渲染 | `render.py` + `render.sh` | `src/node/render.js` —— 一次 bundle、逐场景 ProRes HQ 分段、内容键缓存 |
| 音频混音 | `mix.py`（numpy） | ffmpeg `sidechaincompress` + `alimiter` + `loudnorm` |
| 配音 | `narrate.py`（qwen-tts） | 本地 IndexTTS-2.5 的 HTTP 桥 |
| 逐词时间 | `asr.py`（mlx-whisper） | `openai-whisper` + 对着已知原稿做强制对齐（`py/align.py`） |
| 浏览器 | 系统 Chrome | Windows 自带的 Edge |
| ffmpeg/ffprobe | `brew install` | npm 里带的静态二进制 |

不需要 WSL。不需要 Homebrew。`PATH` 里不用有 `ffmpeg`。Python 只用于两个叶子脚本
（强制对齐、中文字体子集化），解释器路径由你在配置里指定。

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `papercut_list` | — | 列出已有集、时长、场景数、是否已渲染 |
| `papercut_plan` | `idea`, `slug?`, `comp?`, `lines?` | 生成骨架目录并返回 7 行脚本模板 |
| `papercut_storyboard` | `slug` | 从真实帧计划反推运镜 / 转场 / 音效表 |
| `papercut_voice` | `slug`, `engine?`, `force?`, `model?`, `keepWarm?` | 逐行本地合成、裁静音、强制对齐，产出 `voiceover.wav` + 字幕 + 帧计划 |
| `papercut_render` | `slug`, `force?`, `workers?`, `conc?` | 分段渲染后一次 x264 编码并混入音轨 |
| `papercut_qa` | `slug`, `every?`, `scale?` | 每 N 帧抽一张带帧号的 contact sheet，供人/模型看图验收 |
其余的事 —— 写场景、写钩子、挑素材 —— 是 agent 的活，由九个技能引导。

由 `npm run skills` 装进 `<DSH_HOME>/skills`，DSH 会实时发现（不用重启）：

`papercut-explainer`（总入口 / 路由）· `papercut-strategy` · `papercut-hook` ·
`papercut-script` · `papercut-storyboard` · `papercut-build` · `papercut-voice` ·
`papercut-qa` · `papercut-setup`（本机工具链体检）。

在 DSH 里说「做一个关于 X 的剪纸短片」，路由技能会接手往下走。
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile papercut add "link:D:/path/to/dsh-papercut"

cd D:/path/to/dsh-papercut
node scripts/install-skills.mjs

readme.section: 在 DSH 里说「检查我的 papercut 安装」 -> 走 papercut-setup 的 doctor

readme.text:
`dsh-papercut` 驱动的是一个**工作区**目录，里面放上游素材库和渲染工程。
插件会从自己的包目录（再退到当前工作目录）逐级向上找 `app/node_modules` +
`src/papercut-explainer-main/library`，所以 `link:` 装法和从 npm 装的副本都能零配置跑。
要指到别处就用 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `root`，或设 `PAPERCUT_ROOT` 环境变量。

```
<root>/
  app/                          Remotion 工程（node_modules 里有 remotion / ffmpeg-static / ...）
  src/papercut-explainer-main/  上游 MIT 素材库（kit、音频引擎、场景模板）
  episodes/<slug>/              一集一个目录

用 `papercut-setup`（或 `node tools/bin/papercut.mjs list`）查看缺什么。

- **Windows 10/11**，装有 Edge（任何较新的 Edge 都带 Remotion 需要的 headless Chromium）
- **Node 22+**
- 一个 Python 3.11 venv，装有 `openai-whisper` + `fonttools` —— 只给对齐器和中文字体
  子集化用。在插件配置里用 `python:` 指过去。
- **可选**：`127.0.0.1:7865` 上的本地 TTS HTTP 桥（IndexTTS-2.5）。插件只探 `/health`
  并告诉你该怎么起服务；它**不会**自己去拉模型 —— 那会白占显存。

| | |
|---|---|
| 配音 + 对齐 | 7 行，语音 24.1 秒，每行合成约 4 秒、对齐约 3.3 秒 |
| 冷渲染 | 55 秒 —— bundle 2 秒，824 帧分 3 个 worker，最终编码 9 秒 |
| 改一个场景后渲染 | 20 秒 —— 其余六段全部命中缓存 |
| 成片 | H.264 High / yuv420p / bt709 / 8.6 Mbps / −14.7 LUFS / −1.0 dBTP / 0 解码错误 |
